verdict.rationale: Aider's evidence covers single-session editing, git auto-commits, /undo, and scripting via --message or Coder.run. Nothing documents a native way to run several task attempts in parallel and compare them before choosing one. Scripting is only a developer building block a user could build parallel runs from, and the community comment about agents comparing PR results is hypothetical, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one
